description: The one climate, per docs/adr/0016: the calendar the weather kinds are drawn against, the drying timings every wet kind shares, how the wind drifts, and what snow on the ground does. seasonDays 5 means a ten-day run sees two seasons (the owner's call, 2026-09-06). The drying timings moved here from weather.rain: wet after ten seconds in it, dry an hour after it stops, twelve minutes by a lit fire. Wind re-rolls daily at strength 0.6 within windDriftDeg (45) of the prevailing direction -- the attention field's own calibrated lean (0.6 / -0.2), which the district siting was measured under; a free daily direction was the first cut and the harness read it as a coin toss per seed (docs/23's Weather record). Read by SimWeather only.
